scope: Focused isolated controls; not the full project mutation proof

controls.name: public path replacement
controls.detail: 3 failing assertion(s): refuses to replace an active socket and keeps routing to its owner; preserves an existing file or symlink (symlink=false) on failed start

controls.name: close removes replacement
controls.detail: 1 failing assertion(s): closing a displaced owner preserves its replacement socket

controls.name: project omitted from address
controls.detail: 1 failing assertion(s): assigns different addresses to separate projects and runs

controls.name: run omitted from address
controls.detail: 1 failing assertion(s): assigns different addresses to separate projects and runs

controls.name: foreground broker skips SIGINT cleanup
controls.detail: 3 failing assertion(s): foreground broker cleans up on SIGINT and explicit socket can restart; foreground broker cleans up on SIGTERM and explicit socket can restart

controls.name: act omits explicit run socket requirement
controls.anchor: if (!opts.socket) throw new Error("Specify a run socket with --socket or JARVIS_BROKER_SOCKET; use the path printed by jarvis broker.");
controls.detail: 1 failing assertion(s): act requires an explicit run socket instead of falling back to a global broker

controls.name: foreground broker skips SIGHUP cleanup
controls.detail: 1 failing assertion(s): foreground broker cleans up on SIGHUP and explicit socket can restart

controls.name: lock reclaimed without a marker
controls.detail: 4 failing assertion(s): never reclaims a stale lock another live reclaimer is already handling, and never loops forever; recovers repeated crashed reclaimers with bounded names and respects a live deepest owner

controls.name: a dead reclaimer's marker blocks forever
controls.detail: 2 failing assertion(s) + 3 refused by Jarvis guards: recovers when a reclaimer died holding its marker, at any depth; never recreates a legacy descendant after it disappears while a bounded competitor claims the parent
controls.replacesExisting: a dead reclaimer's marker blocks forever

controls.name: D5 bounded names removed
controls.detail: 2 failing assertion(s) + 1 refused by Jarvis guards: recovers repeated crashed reclaimers with bounded names and respects a live deepest owner; never recreates a legacy descendant after it disappears while a bounded competitor claims the parent

controls.name: M1 legacy creation name depends on existence
controls.detail: 1 failing assertion(s): never recreates a legacy descendant after it disappears while a bounded competitor claims the parent

controls.name: D4 conflicting answer throw to silent return
controls.anchor: if (firstDecision !== decision) throw new Error(`already answered: ${firstDecision}`);
controls.detail: 5 failing assertion(s): keeps the first valid answer when approve is followed by reject; keeps the first valid answer when reject is followed by approve

controls.name: D4 first linked answer find to findLast
controls.detail: 2 failing assertion(s): honors the first valid linked answer in older ledgers (approve then reject); honors the first valid linked answer in older ledgers (reject then approve)

controls.name: D4 linked answer payload hash predicate removed
controls.anchor: return d.approvalId === openData?.approvalId && d.payloadHash === hash && d.op === op
controls.detail: 1 failing assertion(s): does not accept a linked answer whose payload hash differs from its request

controls.name: D4 operation-only approval binding (prior shared control)
controls.detail: 3 failing assertion(s): does not let an approval cover a changed payload; does not accept an answer linked to a different approval request
controls.replacesExisting: broker approves by operation, not payload

controls.name: D8 hook exact-key validation bypassed
controls.detail: 2 failing assertion(s): fails when the plugin has asynchronous tripwire; fails when the plugin has tripwire with tiny timeout

controls.name: D8 old truthy registration check
controls.detail: 12 failing assertion(s): fails when the plugin has missing SessionStart; fails when the plugin has empty PreToolUse
